blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — ACT Teachers Rep. Antonio Tinio on Thursday urged the Senate to make “necessary corrections” to the House-approved P7.2-trillion national budget for 2027 as senators prepare to review the spending plan. In a statement, Tinio said he hopes the Senate will strip “pork” from the budget bill instead of adding its own discretionary projects for next year. “The Senate should review the amendments made by the House, particularly the increases in hard (infrastructure) and soft (ayuda) pork items at the expense of education, health, and personnel benefits,” he said. “The swapping out of funding for a handful of foreign-assisted […]...
